title: Canon of the Twin Moment
summary: A canon of living in two moments at once so that one hand is early and the other late and the foe's guard breaks between them.

title: Treatise of the Paired Echo
summary: A treatise on repeating a blow or a guard or a cleansing touch as a matched echo a moment after the first so that one act lands twice.

title: The Azure Interval Mastery
summary: A mastery of the interval between two moments in which the student cuts and binds and mends and at the height of skill slips through a barrier.

title: The Wind-Sworn Tempo Canon
summary: A canon of tempo that a wind-sworn student swears to the gusts and then lends to allies and withholds from those who stand against the oath.

title: Treatise of the Bearing Delay
summary: A treatise on laying a delay along a held bearing so that everything which crosses the line is slowed or sealed or lands late.

title: The Oath of the Unbroken Span
summary: A sworn manual of keeping one long span of time whole so that no blow breaks it and every cut and mend and cleansing is carried through it.
